WITH cash_flows AS (
    SELECT investor_id, 
           SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END) AS inflows,
           SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS outflows
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
net_cash_flow AS (
    SELECT investor_id, 
           (inflows - outflows) AS net_cash_flow,
           (inflows + outflows) AS total_signed_cash_flow
    FROM cash_flows
),
holdings AS (
    SELECT investor_id, 
           SUM(current_value) AS total_holding_value
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001

sector_investments AS (
    SELECT investor_id, 
           SUM(total_investment) AS total_sector_investment

    GROUP BY investor_id
)

    p.risk_tolerance,
    ROUND(AVG(ncf.net_cash_flow), 2) AS avg_net_cash_flow,

    ROUND(AVG(h.total_holding_value), 2) AS avg_total_holding_value,

LEFT JOIN holdings h ON p.investor_id = h.investor_id
LEFT JOIN sector_investments si ON p.investor_id = si.investor_id

WITH cash_flows AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(CASE 
                 WHEN type IN ('Deposit', 'SIP', 'Interest Credit', 'Tax Refund', 'Dividend Reinvestment', 'Lump Sum') 
                 THEN amount 
                 ELSE -amount 
               END) AS net_cash_flow
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
holdings AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(current_value - cost) AS total_holding_gain
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
    WHERE cost IS NOT NULL AND current_value IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
scenario_shifts AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(new_allocation_pct - current_allocation_pct) AS total_allocation_shift
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
    WHERE current_allocation_pct IS NOT NULL AND new_allocation_pct IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
combined_scores AS (
    SELECT p.investor_id,
           cf.net_cash_flow,
           h.total_holding_gain,
           s.total_allocation_shift
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
    JOIN cash_flows cf ON p.investor_id = cf.investor_id
    JOIN holdings h ON p.investor_id = h.investor_id
    JOIN scenario_shifts s ON p.investor_id = s.investor_id
),
normalised_scores AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           (net_cash_flow - MIN(net_cash_flow) OVER()) * 1.0 / 
             (MAX(net_cash_flow) OVER() - MIN(net_cash_flow) OVER()) AS norm_cash_flow,
           (total_holding_gain - MIN(total_holding_gain) OVER()) * 1.0 / 
             (MAX(total_holding_gain) OVER() - MIN(total_holding_gain) OVER()) AS norm_holding_gain,
           (total_allocation_shift - MIN(total_allocation_shift) OVER()) * 1.0 / 
             (MAX(total_allocation_shift) OVER() - MIN(total_allocation_shift) OVER()) AS norm_allocation_shift
    FROM combined_scores
)

FROM (
    SELECT investor_id,
           100 * ((norm_cash_flow + norm_holding_gain + norm_allocation_shift) / 3) AS composite_score

    GROUP BY investor_id

    WHERE current_allocation_pct IS NOT NULL AND new_allocation_pct IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
combined_scores AS (
    SELECT c.investor_id,
           c.net_cash_flow,
           h.total_holding_gain,

    FROM cash_flows c
    JOIN holdings h ON c.investor_id = h.investor_id
    JOIN scenario_shifts s ON c.investor_id = s.investor_id
),

    SELECT investor_id,

)

raw_scores AS (

        COALESCE(rebal.total_rebalance_amount, 0) AS rebal_amt,

        COALESCE(goal.avg_goal_shortfall, 0) AS goal_short
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
    INNER JOIN cash ON p.investor_id = cash.investor_id
    INNER JOIN rebal ON p.investor_id = rebal.investor_id
    INNER JOIN scen ON p.investor_id = scen.investor_id
    INNER JOIN goal ON p.investor_id = goal.investor_id
),
min_max AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(net_cf) AS min_cf, MAX(net_cf) AS max_cf,
        MIN(rebal_amt) AS min_ra, MAX(rebal_amt) AS max_ra,
        MIN(alloc_shift) AS min_as, MAX(alloc_shift) AS max_as,

    FROM raw_scores

  GROUP BY investor_id

risk_scores AS (
  SELECT

    risk_score
  FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001

combined_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    cf.investor_id,
    cf.net_cash_flow,
    si.total_sector_investment,
    als.total_allocation_shift,
    rs.risk_score
  FROM cash_flows cf
  JOIN sector_investments si ON cf.investor_id = si.investor_id
